items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Good guitar player Lang was. ... INTERVIEWEE: He was. He was. He was...

ctx.x: Who's the guitar player on this?
Lang. Eddie Lang. He's dead now. I'm bowing that. Ha ha. Now I used the bow later on. I'm bowing that. Any piece that wasn't hot I'd use the bow. Ha ha. I'm bowing that.
Any piece that wasn't hot I'd use the bow. Ha ha. Good guitar player Lang was. Joe Venuti was. He was.
